topic_template_lines: From the outset, the author (adverb) begins their piece by (adverb) presenting a (type of argument),
(adverb) highlighting …, to predispose (PREPARE) the audience to the subsequent arguments
topic_examples: From the outset, ABU HALEEB wholeheartedly begins their piece by forthrightly presenting a community-based argument zealously highlighting the importance of sacrifice in the medical profession, to predispose medical staff to his subsequent arguments.

From the outset, Mick wholeheartedly begins her piece by candidly presenting a medicalbased argument, passionately highlighting the health benefits that come out of swimming, to predispose VCE students to her subsequent arguments.
argument_types: Sentimental argument - reminding you of the past
Logistics argument - systems behind how to make something a reality
linking_template: Ultimately, the (author) (adverb) commences their piece by shepherding them into a heightened state of ... by establishing ...
linking_example: Ultimately, the Art and Media Club vehemently commences their piece by shepherding them into a heightened state of joy and reminiscence by establishing their outstanding connection with the new library and the monumental impacts of the old library on generations.
